killProcess.groupCaption: Groups helper processes, such as browser tabs, under the copy of the same program that started them.
win.processes.protected: Windows needs this process. It can’t be ended from here.
win.processes.noWindowsNote: This process has no window to close, so it is ended right away. Unsaved work in it is lost.
win.processes.accessDeniedFormat: Windows did not let the app end “%@” because it runs as administrator or as another user. Restart this app as administrator to end it.
win.processes.relaunchFailedFormat: %@ quit but could not be started again.
win.processes.adminTitle: Processes of administrators and other users
win.processes.adminNote: They can only be ended while this app runs as administrator.
win.processes.showUdpCaption: UDP has no listening state, so every open UDP socket is listed.
